prompt: Implement render(template, context) in tmpl.py, a small template language: {{ name }} inserts a value, with dotted paths (user.name looks up dict keys or attributes) and filters after | (upper, lower, title, default:"text" for a missing or None value, and join:", " for lists), chained left to right; inserted values are HTML-escaped (& < > " ') unless the last filter is safe. {% if path %}...{% else %}...{% endif %} (else optional, truthiness of the value, nesting allowed) and {% for x in path %}...{% endfor %} (nesting allowed; inside, loop.index counts from 1 and loop.last is True on the last item). A missing path without default renders as an empty string. Raise ValueError for an unknown filter or unbalanced tags.
